questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: Solve for x if 2^(2x + 1) = 32.
questions.explanation: Express 32 in base 2: 32 = 2^5. Equating exponents gives 2x + 1 = 5 => 2x = 4 => x = 2.
questions.explanation_pidgin: Change 32 to base 2 wey be 2^5. Then 2x + 1 = 5, so 2x = 4 and x = 2.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: Find the derivative of y = 3x^2 - 5x + 7 with respect to x.
questions.explanation: Using the power rule d/dx(ax^n) = anx^(n-1): d/dx(3x^2) = 6x, d/dx(-5x) = -5, and d/dx(7) = 0. Thus dy/dx = 6x - 5.
questions.explanation_pidgin: Bring power 2 down multiply 3x e go give 6x, -5x go remain -5, constant 7 go turn 0. Answer na 6x - 5.
